note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) from live data observed 2026-09-17. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: Over the last 90 days, which machine lost the most time to breakdowns, and how much?
checks: Answered or partial. Names the workstation with the most breakdown minutes in DowntimeEntry over 90 days (ties accepted) in evidence_records, by its number or full name as a whole token. Unevaluated when downtime recorded without a workstation is at least the top machine's total, since which machine lost most cannot then be told. Subject and outcome rules: harness/verifiers/team04.py docstring.
